groups.place: THE NEW WAR + DOJO, TENNO LAB

rows.label: The New War
rows.note: unlocks Narmer Bounties; nothing here works without it

rows.label: Tenno Lab: Tonbo, then Venato
rows.note: 3 days for the Venato research; skip if already researched

conditions: Ghost (x1) tier pays 10,000 credits, 1 Tellurium, 275 Rubedo, 225 Plastids and 3,500 Salvage for the Venato research; bigger clans pay x3 up to x100.

groups.sub: or Plains of Eidolon, Cetus, same rates

rows.label: Narmer Isoplast
rows.note: 1-3 per stage roll, about 2.5-3 per full bounty

conditions: Boosters and Retriever mods don't affect Isoplast.
Don't trade Isoplast for standing until Venato and anything else that needs it is built.
bonuses: Farm Caliban, Korumm, Verdilac and Nepheri at the same time; they share these bounties and the Isoplast.
Volt, Nova or Wisp speed up drone-escort stages.

disclosures.title: why Fortuna over Cetus
disclosures.body: Drops are identical. Vallis bounties stay closer to town and above ground; Plains bounties have cave objectives that break bonus conditions. On Cetus, a Narmer Grineer captain disarmed before every Vomvalyst dies becomes unkillable and bricks the bounty; Chesa Kubrow is the usual culprit.

groups.activity: Railjack: board the Murex, kill the 20 Sentients

rows.label: Anomaly Shard
rows.note: flashing red Grineer node; moves every 30 minutes

rows.label: Exceptional Sentient Core
rows.note: Sentients aboard the Murex can drop them
rows.alt: two Teralysts, 4 each; or Onkko's conversion blueprint, 500 Quills standing

conditions: If the Railjack mission fails, you lose the shard even after clearing the Murex; aborting or failing a chain discards earlier rewards from it.
bonuses: Some players use a worldstate tracker site to find the Murex node.

disclosures.title: core conversion
disclosures.body: Onkko's reusable Exceptional Sentient Core Conversion blueprint turns 10 Intact Cores, 1 Radian Sentirum and 1 Heart Nyth into 10 Exceptional.

groups.sub: Twin Horns, Seaside Ruin, Hek's Stiletto, Er-Phryah's Vigil, Renthi Spring, The Seethe
groups.activity: break mineral deposits in the low-lying areas

rows.label: Venato
rows.note: 20,000 cr, 16 Narmer Isoplast, 5 Anomaly Shard, 5 Exceptional Sentient Core, 60 Iradite

disclosures.title: not Venato Prime
disclosures.body: Venato Prime is a separate item with its own relic farm.
